spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-001: Initialize repository structure and base shells
spreadsheet.description: Set up Next.js frontend application (App Router), backend API service (FastAPI), configure Tailwind CSS, and UI component libraries.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-002: Initialize Spec Kit and LangGraph multi-agent workspace
spreadsheet.description: Create initial markdown specs, stories, acceptance criteria, and configure LangGraph agent scaffolding for the 6-agent cockpit.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-003: Populate synthetic CSV datasets
spreadsheet.description: Populate products.csv, inventory.csv, planogram.csv, and shelf_events.csv initial datasets for data hydration.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-004: Configure database connection and DDL schemas
spreadsheet.description: Create products, inventory, planogram, shelf_events, audit_logs, and traceability_matrix tables using SQLite / PostgreSQL with performance indexes.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-005: Implement CSV data seed startup scripts
spreadsheet.description: Write automated startup script to load CSV seed data into relational database tables upon application initialization.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-006: REQ-001 Asynchronous Shelf Image Upload & Ingestion
spreadsheet.description: Build multipart form-data upload endpoint supporting image/jpeg and image/png, zone ID, and associate ID validation. Return 202 Accepted with QUEUED status and polling URI.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-007: Implement Data Privacy Masking Utility
spreadsheet.description: Implement privacy masking / face-blurring utility to strip potential customer or associate faces from captured shelf images before persistent storage.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-008: REQ-002 Shelf Gap & Anomaly Detection with Graceful Degradation
spreadsheet.description: Create service to simulate shelf gap detection, bounding boxes, and OCR price-label comparison within 2,500ms timeout with fallback to synthetic anomaly records.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-009: REQ-003 Planogram & Inventory Cross-Reference
spreadsheet.description: Build matching engine utilizing B-tree indexes to correlate detected SKU against planogram expected facings and inventory on-shelf/backroom quantities.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-010: REQ-004 Prioritized Recommendation Generation with Point-in-Time Snapshots
spreadsheet.description: Implement recommendation scoring algorithm based on unit price, velocity, and stock status, capturing immutable point-in-time financial snapshots.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-011: REQ-005 Optimistic-Locked Human-in-the-Loop Approval Gate
spreadsheet.description: Create task approval endpoint enforcing conditional version matching (409 Conflict on mismatch), incrementing version, and writing immutable entries to audit_logs.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-012: REQ-006 & REQ-007 Issue Impact Dashboard & Traceability APIs
spreadsheet.description: Expose endpoints for aggregated time-series event metrics with snapshot valuation and requirement traceability matrix mapping (REQ-001 through REQ-008).

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-013: Build Navigation, Layout Shell & Component Library
spreadsheet.description: Create top navigation bar, sidebar routing, drag-and-drop file uploader, bounding box overlay component, and recommendation task action cards.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-014: Build Store Associate / Manager Dashboard Page
spreadsheet.description: Develop dashboard displaying summary metrics for shelf issues, out-of-stock items, recovery impact, and active task review queue.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-015: Build Shelf Inspection & Upload Page
spreadsheet.description: Implement end-to-end frontend flow for uploading shelf images, running analysis, viewing AI detection results, and triggering recommendations.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-016: Build SDLC Cockpit & Traceability Page
spreadsheet.description: Create interactive LangGraph agent timeline view and full requirement traceability click-through tree linking requirements to code and test paths.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-017: Build Governance & Audit Log Panel
spreadsheet.description: Develop governance view displaying compliance checklist, human approval audit trail, privacy notes, and model limitation warnings.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-018: Implement Pytest Unit & Integration Test Suites
spreadsheet.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for image upload workflow, shelf gap detection, backroom inventory check, human approval gate, and traceability link integrity.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-019: End-to-End Demo Polish, ADR Documentation & Antigravity Evidence Pack
spreadsheet.description: Verify happy path execution, generate ADR documents, bundle Google Antigravity artifacts (code diffs, browser recordings), and record fallback demo video.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-020: Resolve Optimistic Locking Race Condition on Rapid Task Approvals
spreadsheet.description: Fix edge case where simultaneous manager requests bypass version check under high concurrency, ensuring strict 409 Conflict response.
